newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PRZYMIERZE NAV UP 4.1, 3.4 PCT IN SEPT-DEC.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PRZYMIERZE NAV UP 4.1, 3.4 PCT IN SEPT-DEC.

text.p: Polish Eurofundusz 1 of mutual fund company Przymierze Towarzystwo Funduszy Powierniczych SA net asset value per unit type A rose 4.14 percent and type B 3.38 percent last year, Przymierze said in a statement.
Przymierze said Eurofundusz's unit A rose to 101.2 zlotys and B to 100.98 zlotys.
It said Eurofundusz 1, which started operating in September 1996 had an operating profit of 186,100 zlotys in 1996.
Eurofundusz 1 had 34.1 percent of shares in its portfolio, 30.1 percent of bonds, 25.4 percent of T-bills, 4.2 percent of NFI units with other assets accounting for 6.2 percent.
Przymierze is 51-percent owned by Polish state-owned Bank Pekao SA and 49- percent owned by the U.S.'s Alliance Capital Management LP .
